title: Multi-Agent Contract Design with a Budget
title_zh: 预算约束下的多智能体合约设计
title_primary: 预算约束下的多智能体合约设计
title_secondary: Multi-Agent Contract Design with a Budget
authors: Sumit Goel, Wade Hann-Caruthers
official: 官方在线 2026-09-17 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We study a multi-agent contract design problem with moral hazard. In our model, each agent exerts costly effort towards an individual task at which it may either succeed or fail, and the principal, who wishes to encourage effort, has an exclusive-use budget that it can use to reward the agents. A motivating application is crowdsourcing for innovation, where a fixed budget is provided to a crowdsourcing platform to use for rewarding participants based on their submissions. Our main contribution is to introduce a novel class of contracts, which we call Luce contracts, and show that there is always a Luce contract that is optimal. A Luce contract assigns weights and a priority order to the agents, and distributes the entire budget among the highest-priority successful agents in proportion to their weights. Furthermore, we characterize effort profiles that can be implemented by Luce contracts and show that Luce contracts offer a way to mitigate the uncertainty in total payments compared to alternative contracts—such as piece-rate or bonus-pool contracts—suggesting their desirability even in environments without budget constraints.
abstract_zh: 我们研究一个具有道德风险的多智能体合同设计问题。在我们的模型中，每个智能体针对一项个体任务付出有成本的努力，该任务可能成功也可能失败，而委托人希望激励努力，并拥有一个可专门用于奖励智能体的排他性使用预算。一个具有启发性的应用是面向创新的众包，其中向众包平台提供固定预算，用于根据参与者的提交对其进行奖励。我们的主要贡献是引入一类新颖的合同，我们称之为Luce合同，并证明始终存在一个最优的Luce合同。Luce合同为智能体分配权重和优先级顺序，并将全部预算按权重比例分配给优先级最高的成功智能体。此外，我们刻画了可由Luce合同实施的努力配置，并表明与替代合同——如计件合同或奖金池合同——相比，Luce合同提供了一种缓解总支付不确定性的方式，这表明即使在没有预算约束的环境中，它们也是可取的。

title: Spatial structure of land value potential after land consolidation using spatial econometric modelling
title_zh: 土地整理后土地价值潜力的空间结构：基于空间计量模型的研究
title_primary: 土地整理后土地价值潜力的空间结构：基于空间计量模型的研究
title_secondary: Spatial structure of land value potential after land consolidation using spatial econometric modelling
authors: Mevlut Uyan
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-16 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Land consolidation (LC) is a widely adopted land management instrument for improving agricultural efficiency through parcel restructuring and reducing land fragmentation. However, how LC reshapes the spatial distribution of land value remains insufficiently understood. This study investigates the spatial determinants of post-consolidation land value potential (LVP) using parcel-level data from an agricultural LC project in Türkiye. The analysis examines the effects of changes in parcel compactness (ΔCI), fragmentation, and pre-consolidation LVP within a spatial econometric framework. The average LVP increased from 0.491 before LC to 0.737 after LC, representing an improvement of approximately 50%. OLS residuals exhibited significant spatial autocorrelation (Moran's I = 0.198, p < 0.001), confirming that conventional regression was inadequate. Model comparison identified the Spatial Error Model (SEM) as the most appropriate specification (AIC=-510.51), indicating that post-consolidation LVP is primarily influenced by spatially structured contextual factors rather than direct parcel-to-parcel interactions. The findings demonstrate that LC reshapes rather than eliminates inherited spatial value structures and highlight the importance of accounting for spatial dependence when evaluating rural land management interventions. Methodologically, the study provides a reproducible spatial econometric framework that can support more robust and equitable evaluations of LC programmes.
abstract_zh: 土地整理（LC）是一种被广泛采用的土地管理工具，旨在通过地块重组和减少土地细碎化来提高农业效率。然而，土地整理如何重塑土地价值的空间分布仍缺乏充分认识。本研究利用土耳其一个农业土地整理项目的地块级数据，考察整理后土地价值潜力（LVP）的空间决定因素。分析在一个空间计量经济学框架内检验地块紧凑度变化（ΔCI）、细碎化以及整理前LVP的影响。平均LVP从土地整理前的0.491上升至整理后的0.737，提升约50%。OLS残差表现出显著的空间自相关（Moran's I = 0.198，p < 0.001），证实传统回归并不充分。模型比较表明，空间误差模型（SEM）是最合适的设定（AIC=-510.51），说明整理后LVP主要受具有空间结构的语境因素影响，而非直接的地块间相互作用。研究结果表明，土地整理重塑而非消除了继承性的空间价值结构，并凸显了在评估农村土地管理干预措施时考虑空间依赖性的重要性。在方法上，本研究提供了一个可复现的空间计量经济学框架，可支持对土地整理项目进行更稳健且更公平的评估。

title: Immigration and Child Mortality during the Age of Mass Migration
title_zh: 大规模移民时代的移民与儿童死亡率
title_primary: 大规模移民时代的移民与儿童死亡率
title_secondary: Immigration and Child Mortality during the Age of Mass Migration
authors: Katherine Eriksson, Peter Zhixian Lin, Gregory Niemesh
official: 官方在线 2026-09-14 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: In the late nineteenth century, Americans feared that crowded immigrant neighborhoods were spreading disease through industrial cities. We study this claim using newly constructed town-level panel data from Massachusetts, 1860 to 1915, a setting uniquely suited to this exercise because its early vital registration system allows consistent measurement of mortality before national registration became widespread. Using a shift-share instrumental variable strategy based on historical settlement patterns, we estimate the effect of local exposure to immigration on mortality. The relevant question is not whether immigrant families themselves experienced higher mortality, but whether immigration altered the local disease environment more broadly. We find that increases in the foreign-born share significantly raised infant and child mortality, with the infant effect falling disproportionately on the post-neonatal period. Mechanical changes in the composition of births by parent nativity account for only a portion of the estimated effect, implying that the results are not driven primarily by higher mortality among immigrant births. Instead, the evidence is consistent with increased exposure to immigrants, communicable disease, and spillovers to children of native-born parents. These findings highlight immigration as one factor shaping the mortality transition in crowded high-mortality environments.
abstract_zh: 在19世纪末，美国人担心拥挤的移民社区正在通过工业城市传播疾病。我们利用新构建的马萨诸塞州1860年至1915年城镇层面面板数据来研究这一说法，该背景特别适合此项研究，因为其早期生命登记系统使得在全国性登记普及之前能够一致地测量死亡率。我们采用基于历史定居模式的移动份额工具变量策略，估计当地移民暴露对死亡率的影响。相关问题不在于移民家庭自身是否经历了更高的死亡率，而在于移民是否更广泛地改变了当地的疾病环境。我们发现，外国出生人口比例的上升显著提高了婴儿和儿童死亡率，其中婴儿效应不成比例地落在新生儿后期。父母出生地构成变化所导致的出生构成的机械性变化仅能解释估计效应的一部分，这意味着结果并非主要由移民出生婴儿更高的死亡率所驱动。相反，证据与移民暴露增加、传染病以及向本土出生父母子女的溢出效应相一致。这些发现凸显了移民是塑造拥挤高死亡率环境中死亡率转变的一个因素。

title: DP20012 Regulation, Supervision, and Bank Risk-Taking
title_zh: 监管、监督与银行风险承担
title_primary: 监管、监督与银行风险承担
title_secondary: DP20012 Regulation, Supervision, and Bank Risk-Taking
authors: Rafael Repullo
official: 官方在线 2025-03-07 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper presents a model of the interaction between a bank and a supervisor. The bank privately chooses the risk of its investment portfolio and the supervisor collects nonverifiable information on the future solvency of the bank and, based on of this information, may decide on its early liquidation. The paper characterizes the liquidation decision of the supervisor and the risk-taking decision of the bank. In line with recent empirical literature, the paper shows that supervision is effective in ameliorating the bank's risk-shifting incentives, and that a tougher supervisor leads to lower risk-taking. It also shows that higher noise in the supervisory information may be conducive to lower risk-taking, but that it always reduces welfare.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个银行与监管者互动的模型。银行私下选择其投资组合的风险水平，而监管者收集关于银行未来偿付能力的不可验证信息，并基于此信息可能决定是否提前清算银行。本文刻画了监管者的清算决策与银行的风险承担决策。与近期实证文献一致，本文表明监管在缓解银行风险转移激励方面是有效的，且更严格的监管者会导致更低的风险承担。同时，本文还指出，监管信息中更高的噪声可能有助于降低风险承担，但始终会降低社会福利。

title: Designing renewable energy auctions for high realization probability — CfD and payment-only auctions
title_zh: 设计高实现概率的可再生能源拍卖——差价合约与仅支付拍卖
title_primary: 设计高实现概率的可再生能源拍卖——差价合约与仅支付拍卖
title_secondary: Designing renewable energy auctions for high realization probability — CfD and payment-only auctions
authors: Runxi Wang, Karl‐Martin Ehrhart
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-03 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: In recent years, different instruments for renewable energy expansion have been debated. Among the support and hedging instruments, two-sided contracts for difference (CfDs) have become the default in many countries and are promoted by the European Commission. On the other hand, payment-only auctions have also become established, where the electricity sales are unregulated, but the winners must pay for the right to build energy plants. Focusing on a high realization probability and the induced welfare effects, we compare two-sided CfDs with payment-only auctions. Contrary to the conventional wisdom, the non-realization risk is higher with auctioned CfDs than with payment-only auctions and is exacerbated by risk aversion, when developers can cope with both options. CfDs are particularly useful when developers need support for implementing their projects. Against this backdrop and considering asymmetric information, i.e., developers know best the economic conditions of their projects, we propose a design in which developers decide competitively between a CfD auction and a payment-only auction and which enhances the realization probability.

title: Corruption and Capital Investment: Worldwide Evidence
title_zh: 腐败与资本投资：全球证据
title_primary: 腐败与资本投资：全球证据
title_secondary: Corruption and Capital Investment: Worldwide Evidence
authors: Wei-Fong Pan
official: 官方在线 2026-09-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Can international anti-corruption monitoring stimulate private investment? We examine staggered reviews across jurisdictions under the United Nations Convention against Corruption (UNCAC), using firm-year observations from 84 economies over 2003–2023. We document that reviews are followed by improvements in economy-level corruption-control indicators. Local-projections difference-in-differences estimates indicate that reviews raise firms’ capital expenditure relative to assets by 1.2126 percentage points, equivalent to 20% of the sample mean. Dynamic estimates show no systematic pre-review adjustment, and the result is robust to influential-economy exclusions, economy-level reweighting, alternative sample restrictions, lagged-outcome controls, and alternative staggered-adoption estimators. Investment responses are stronger in high-corruption economies and developing economies and among firms that are more financially constrained, government dependent, domestically concentrated, or reliant on irreversible capital. These patterns are consistent with international oversight reducing corruption-related institutional risk, financing frictions, and the value of delaying investment. UNCAC reviews are also followed by increases in employment, R&D investment, and leverage. Additional analyses provide no evidence that the increase in investment is accompanied by a systematic decline in investment efficiency. Overall, the findings show that a non-punitive international peer-review mechanism can affect firms’ real activity, particularly where initial institutional frictions are greater.
abstract_zh: 国际反腐败监督能否激发私人投资？我们利用2003年至2023年间84个经济体的企业年度观测数据，考察了《联合国反腐败公约》（UNCAC）下各司法管辖区交错进行的审议。研究发现，审议之后，经济体层面的腐败控制指标有所改善。局部投影双重差分估计表明，审议使企业资本支出相对于资产的比率提高了1.2126个百分点，相当于样本均值的20%。动态估计显示，审议前不存在系统性调整，且该结果在排除具有影响力的经济体、经济体层面重新加权、替代样本限制、滞后结果控制以及替代交错采纳估计量等情形下依然稳健。投资响应在高腐败经济体和发展中经济体中更为显著，且在财务约束更强、更依赖政府、国内业务集中或依赖不可逆资本的企业中表现更为突出。这些模式与国际监督降低腐败相关制度风险、融资摩擦以及延迟投资的价值相一致。UNCAC审议之后，就业、研发投资和杠杆率也有所上升。进一步分析未发现投资增加伴随投资效率系统性下降的证据。总体而言，研究结果表明，非惩罚性的国际同行审议机制能够影响企业的实际活动，尤其是在初始制度摩擦较大的环境中。

title: Equity Frictions and Firm Ownership
title_zh: 股权摩擦与企业所有权
title_primary: 股权摩擦与企业所有权
title_secondary: Equity Frictions and Firm Ownership
authors: Alessandra Peter
official: 官方在线 2026-08-27 · 来源：RSS
abstract: In this paper, I document systematic heterogeneity in ownership and financing of firms across Eurozone countries. To rationalize these differences, I build a quantitative general equilibrium model of workers and entrepreneurs who choose debt and equity financing of their firms, subject to rich country-specific financial frictions. The novel data on firm ownership and financing, combined with the structure of the model, allows me to quantify the level of debt and equity frictions in each country. Quantitatively, I find much larger output effects from equity frictions: harmonizing them across countries would lead to nearly four times larger output effects compared to debt frictions, and removing them would increase aggregate output by 73\% more. The larger impact on output is due not only to the estimated levels and dispersion of equity frictions but also to the greater risk sharing provided by equity, which further incentivizes entrepreneurs to expand their firms. Through their effect on risk sharing, equity frictions also rationalize the observed negative relationship between equity financing and wealth inequality. Quantitatively, they are responsible for over 70\% of the explained variation in top wealth shares across countries.
abstract_zh: 本文记录了欧元区各国企业在所有权与融资结构上的系统性差异。为解释这些差异，我构建了一个包含工人与企业家的定量一般均衡模型，其中企业家在面临各国特有的金融摩擦条件下，选择债务与股权融资方式。结合关于企业所有权与融资的新颖数据及模型结构，我得以量化各国债务与股权摩擦的程度。定量分析显示，股权摩擦对产出的影响远大于债务摩擦：若各国统一股权摩擦水平，其产出效应将是统一债务摩擦时的近四倍；而完全消除股权摩擦，则可使总产出额外增加73%。股权摩擦对产出的更大影响，不仅源于其估计水平与各国间的离散程度，还在于股权提供的更优风险分担机制，这进一步激励企业家扩大企业规模。通过影响风险分担，股权摩擦还能解释所观察到的股权融资与财富不平等之间的负相关关系。定量上，股权摩擦可解释各国顶层财富份额差异中超过70%的变动。

title: Annual overseas migration and housing markets: Evidence from Australian neighborhoods
title_zh: 年度海外移民与住房市场：来自澳大利亚社区的证据
title_primary: 年度海外移民与住房市场：来自澳大利亚社区的证据
title_secondary: Annual overseas migration and housing markets: Evidence from Australian neighborhoods
authors: Marcel Peruffo, Madeleine Check
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-19 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper examines the impact of net overseas migration (NOM) on residential property marketsusing annual, neighborhood-level data for Australia. We leverage an instrumental variableapproach based on historical immigrant settlement patterns to isolate plausibly exogenousvariation in migration flows. We find that a 1% increase in NOM, as a share of the local population,raises unit rents and prices by 5.0% and 1.3%, respectively, and increases house rents by3.6%. These effects are more pronounced in areas with low rates of dwelling approvals, suggestingthat housing supply constraints amplify the response of prices and rents to migration.In contrast, house prices decline by 1.3%, a pattern concentrated in older neighborhoods andconsistent with displacement dynamics, for which we present supporting evidence.
abstract_zh: 本文利用澳大利亚年度社区层面数据，考察了净海外移民（NOM）对住宅房地产市场的影响。我们采用基于历史移民定居模式的工具变量方法，以隔离移民流动中可能外生的变化。研究发现，NOM占当地人口比例每增加1%，单元房租金和价格分别上涨5.0%和1.3%，独栋房屋租金上涨3.6%。这些效应在住房审批率较低的地区更为显著，表明住房供应约束放大了价格和租金对移民的响应。相比之下，独栋房屋价格下降1.3%，这一模式集中在较老社区，与置换动态一致，我们为此提供了支持性证据。

title: Europe’s productivity is more dynamic than aggregate statistics suggest
title_zh: 欧洲生产率比总体统计数据显示的更具活力
title_primary: 欧洲生产率比总体统计数据显示的更具活力
title_secondary: Europe’s productivity is more dynamic than aggregate statistics suggest
authors: Filippo Di Mauro, Ashim Dubey, Chad Syverson, Alessandro Zona Mattioli
official: 官方在线 2026-08-19 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Aggregate productivity growth in Europe has disappointed over the last two decades, fuelling concerns about competitiveness. This column argues that firm-level evidence points to a more optimistic picture. Productivity differences between firms have stopped widening, and initially low-productivity firms have started moving up the productivity ladder. To speed up productivity convergence within industries, policies should reduce regulatory and administrative barriers to entry and expansion, strengthen competition enforcement, and deepen the Single Market. Investing in a European harmonised framework for firm-level data is also key for understanding productivity developments and devising economic policy.
abstract_zh: 过去二十年，欧洲总体生产率增长令人失望，引发了对竞争力的担忧。本文认为，企业层面的证据指向了一个更为乐观的景象。企业间的生产率差距已停止扩大，起初生产率较低的企业开始向生产率阶梯的上方移动。为了加速行业内生产率的趋同，政策应减少进入和扩张的监管及行政障碍，加强竞争执法，并深化单一市场。投资于欧洲统一的企业层面数据框架，对于理解生产率动态和制定经济政策也至关重要。

title: Europe's regulatory double bind
title_zh: 欧洲的监管双重困境
title_primary: 欧洲的监管双重困境
title_secondary: Europe's regulatory double bind
authors: Marco Perugini
official: 官方在线 2026-08-14 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The European Union's AI Act – the world’s most ambitious regulatory framework for artificial intelligence to date – was supposed to enter into full effect on 2 August 2026. But while the AI Act's transparency layer has come into effect, obliging providers to inform individuals when they interact with an AI system, its high-risk regime – covering biometric identification, recruitment systems, credit scoring, law enforcement, and border control – has been delayed. This column argues that the result is a double bind in which Europe loses regulatory sovereignty whether it enforces its own rules or retreats from them.
abstract_zh: 欧盟《人工智能法案》——迄今为止全球最具雄心的AI监管框架——原定于2026年8月2日全面生效。然而，尽管该法案的透明度条款已生效，要求提供商在个人与AI系统互动时告知对方，但其高风险制度——涵盖生物识别、招聘系统、信用评分、执法及边境管控——已被推迟。本专栏认为，其结果是一种双重困境：无论欧洲是执行自身规则还是退让回避，都将丧失监管主权。

title: Creditors’ Seniority and Sovereign Risk: Evidence from Debt Composition
title_zh: 债权人优先性与主权风险：基于债务构成的证据
title_primary: 债权人优先性与主权风险：基于债务构成的证据
title_secondary: Creditors’ Seniority and Sovereign Risk: Evidence from Debt Composition
authors: Chiara Ferrero & Sansan Vincent de Paul Kambou & Kady Keita
official: 官方在线 2026-07-31 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We provide new evidence on the de facto seniority structure of sovereign debt. Using a measure of the Relative Percentage in Default (RPID) by creditor group for 119 low-income and emerging market countries over the period 1980–2022, we show that debt owed to the IMF and the World Bank is, on average, the most senior, followed by debt owed to official bilateral creditors. Private creditors, notably bondholders and commercial banks, are on average junior to official creditors, with commercial banks being the least prioritized group for repayments. Beyond characterizing the seniority hierarchy, our empirical analysis shows that creditor composition has economically meaningful implications for sovereign risk. abstract: Many public-sector decisions require allocating scarce attention under uncertainty. We examine whether algorithmic risk assessments improve child-protection decisions, where supervisors decide which cases need closer scrutiny. In a randomized evaluation of 4,752 child referrals over 14 months in Northampton County, supervisors received an algorithmic risk score alongside standard case records. Access to the score increased foster-care placements and services for children at highest predicted risk, with little change for lower-risk cases, and it reduced subsequent maltreatment referrals. We find no evidence that the score widened racial disparities in decisions or outcomes, suggesting algorithms can improve targeting while preserving human discretion.

abstract: Many events and policies (treatments) occur at specific spatial locations, with researchers interested in their effects on nearby units. I approach the spatial treatment setting from an experimental perspective: What ideal experiment would we design to estimate the causal effects of spatial treatments? This perspective motivates a comparison between units near realized treatment locations and units near counterfactual (unrealized) candidate locations, which differs from current empirical practice. I derive design‐based standard errors that are straightforward to compute. For observational data, I propose machine learning methods to find counterfactual candidate locations when observable characteristics, rather than potential outcomes, determine treatment probabilities. To accommodate methods for high‐dimensional data in the theory, I extend a double machine learning result to the design‐based framework with spatial correlations. I apply the proposed methods to study the causal effects of grocery stores on foot traffic to nearby businesses during COVID‐19 shelter‐in‐place policies, finding a large positive effect at very short distances, with no effect at larger distances.

abstract: We develop a small open economy model with overlapping generations to analyse the macroeconomic, distributional, and political economy effects of unilateral climate policy under an emissions cap. Carbon pricing lowers wages and thus human wealth, while financial assets continue to earn the world interest rate. This asymmetry generates sharp generational and cross country differences: in creditor economies the young lose most, whereas in debtor economies the old bear the heaviest burden as they must reduce their debt when incomes fall. We compare constant carbon taxes with efficient Hotelling price paths and show that delayed implementation dramatically raises the carbon price needed to meet a fixed emissions cap, especially in debtor economies. Hotelling pricing yields substantially lower near term welfare losses. Across all policies, carbon pricing depresses wages, reduces consumption and human wealth, and induces capital flight; labour supply responses differ by asset position. Public debt can be used to secure majority support for climate policy by shifting part of the burden to future generations—more easily so in creditor economies than debtor ones. Since labour tax cuts counteract the wage depression caused by climate policy, less debt is needed to obtain a political majority.

authors: Wenhui Zhang, Xinli Ke, Vivian Wei Huang
official: 官方在线 2026-07-23 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper develops a novel production function framework that accounts for spatial spillovers in environment‐adjusted agricultural productivity and its components, namely technical change, scale efficiency change and environmental efficiency change, in a single‐stage setting, with greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions incorporated as an undesirable output. A parametric frontier model was specified to measure agricultural environmental efficiency and productivity growth, while allowing for the agricultural outputs to be functions of individuals’ and neighbors’ characteristics. The empirical application concerned the 126 prefectures in the Yangtze River Basin for the period 2000–2020. The empirical findings indicated an upward trend, with an average environment‐adjusted agricultural productivity growth rate of 0.213 during this period when spatial spillovers and agricultural undesirable output were considered, suggesting that agricultural productivity was increasing rapidly and at an accelerating pace. The downstream region experienced the highest rate of productivity improvement, followed by the midstream region, while the upstream region lagged. Technical progress emerged as the dominant driver of environment‐adjusted agricultural productivity growth in the study area.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个新颖的生产函数框架，在单阶段设定中纳入环境调整后的农业全要素生产率及其组成部分（即技术变化、规模效率变化和环境效率变化）的空间溢出效应，并将温室气体排放作为非期望产出纳入模型。通过设定参数前沿模型，在允许农业产出受个体及邻近区域特征影响的前提下，测算了农业环境效率与生产率增长。实证研究以2000—2020年长江流域126个地级市为对象。结果表明，在考虑空间溢出效应和农业非期望产出时，该时期环境调整后的农业全要素生产率呈上升趋势，平均增长率为0.213，表明农业生产力正以加速态势快速提升。下游地区生产率改善幅度最大，中游地区次之，上游地区相对滞后。技术进步是研究区域环境调整后农业全要素生产率增长的主导驱动力。

official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The dollar shortage debate—Paul Samuelson called it “the big open question of our time”—dominated international macroeconomics in the 15 years following the end of World War II. There were two main views regarding its cause: financial frictions that limited capital flows to Western Europe (Kindleberger); and overvalued fixed exchange rates versus the US dollar (Friedman). According to Kindleberger the dollar shortage was attenuated by two real factors that contributed to current account deficits: a large technological gap between the United States and Europe; and European impatience to improve living standards. Kindleberger believed that the current account deficit would prove chronic because of the persistence of the productivity gap, a view that was challenged by Bloomfield who argued that it would dissipate through income growth in Europe. We argue that Kindelberger’s analytical framework is closely connected to the modern intertemporal approach to current account determination; and, also, that the international reserve function of the US dollar—the Triffin dilemma—did not play a role in the dollar shortage.
abstract_zh: 美元短缺的争论——保罗·萨缪尔森称之为“我们时代悬而未决的重大问题”——在二战结束后的15年间主导了国际宏观经济学领域。关于其成因存在两种主要观点：一是限制资本流向西欧的金融摩擦（金德尔伯格）；二是相对于美元被高估的固定汇率（弗里德曼）。金德尔伯格认为，美元短缺因两个导致经常账户赤字的实际因素而减弱：美国与欧洲之间巨大的技术差距；以及欧洲改善生活水平的迫切需求。金德尔伯格认为，由于生产率差距的持续性，经常账户赤字将被证明是长期性的，这一观点遭到布卢姆菲尔德的质疑，后者认为该赤字将随着欧洲收入增长而消散。我们论证：金德尔伯格的分析框架与现代跨期经常账户决定理论密切相关；同时，美元的国际储备功能——特里芬难题——在美元短缺中并未发挥作用。

abstract: We estimate the direct and spillover effects of cannabis legalization on longstanding racial disparities in criminal justice outcomes. We also find spillover increases in hospitalizations involving cannabis and other illegal drugs. However, spillovers on arrests, incarcerations, and crimes involving serious violent or property offenses are insignificant or even decrease. Spillovers on other low-level offenses are insignificant for White but mixed for Black populations. (JEL I12, J15, K14, K41, K42)

abstract: This study quantifies the tax revenue effects of residential land development in Germany. Whereas existing research and policy debates have concentrated on the fiscal returns of commercial land expansion, the tax revenue effects of residential development remain largely unexplored. We estimate the impacts of increases in living space and settlement area on municipal tax revenues using spatial instrumental variable regressions and a nationwide cross-sectional dataset covering all German municipalities. Accounting for spatial spillovers and potential endogeneity, we document a significant positive effect of residential living space expansion on municipal income tax revenues, with substantial heterogeneity between urban and rural municipalities and across regions with differing economic performance. A corresponding analysis of broader settlement area expansion indicates similarly positive effects on total municipal tax revenues. Multiple robustness checks support the validity of these findings. Finally, we outline a simple framework for approximating the fiscal payback period of residential land development by relating estimated revenue effects to average municipal development costs.

abstract: We propose a method for defining, identifying, and estimating the marginal treatment effect (MTE) without imposing the instrumental variable (IV) assumptions of independence, exclusion, and separability (or monotonicity). Under a new definition of the MTE based on reduced‐form treatment error that is statistically independent of the covariates, we find that the relationship between the MTE and standard treatment parameters holds in the absence of IVs. We provide a set of sufficient conditions ensuring the identification of the defined MTE in an environment of essential heterogeneity. The key conditions include a linear restriction on potential outcome regression functions, a nonlinear restriction on the propensity score, and a conditional mean independence restriction which will lead to additive separability. We prove this identification using the notion of semiparametric identification based on functional forms. And we provide an empirical application for the Head Start program to illustrate the usefulness of the proposed method in analyzing heterogenous causal effects when IVs are elusive.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种在不施加工具变量（IV）的独立性、排除性和可分离性（或单调性）假设的情况下，定义、识别和估计边际处理效应（MTE）的方法。基于与协变量统计独立的简化形式处理误差的新MTE定义，我们发现，在没有IV的情况下，MTE与标准处理参数之间的关系仍然成立。我们提供了一组充分条件，确保在本质异质性环境中所定义的MTE的可识别性。关键条件包括对潜在结果回归函数的线性限制、对倾向得分的非线性限制，以及导致加性可分离性的条件均值独立性限制。我们利用基于函数形式的半参数识别概念证明了这一识别。我们还提供了一个针对“领先起步”项目的实证应用，以说明在IV难以获得时，所提方法在分析异质性因果效应中的实用性。

abstract: This paper considers a class of asset-based preferences characterized by intertemporal, multiplicative utility functions over consumption and asset holdings. The optimal investment strategy under such preferences is inherently time-dependent and can be characterized by a sequence of first-order ordinary differential equations (ODEs). Conversely, any time-dependent investment strategy can be rationalized as optimal for some asset-based preference, whereas no time-dependent strategy can be optimal under time-separable preferences. Furthermore, the revealed asset-based preference can be derived as the solution to a recursive system of first-order ODEs. Our analysis establishes a unique correspondence between asset-based preferences and time-dependent investment strategies, demonstrating that the former naturally generate time-dependent investment strategies.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了一类基于资产偏好的特性，这类偏好通过跨期、乘性效用函数对消费和资产持有进行刻画。在此类偏好下，最优投资策略固有地依赖于时间，并可通过一系列一阶常微分方程（ODEs）序列来表征。反之，任何依赖于时间的投资策略都能被合理化，视为某种基于资产偏好的最优选择，而在时间可分离偏好下，则不存在时间依赖策略的最优性。此外，揭示出的基于资产偏好可通过递归一阶常微分方程组求解得出。我们的分析确立了基于资产偏好与时间依赖投资策略之间的唯一对应关系，表明前者自然衍生出时间依赖的投资策略。

title: Access to credit reduces the value of insurance
title_zh: 信贷获取降低了保险的价值
title_primary: 信贷获取降低了保险的价值
title_secondary: Access to credit reduces the value of insurance
authors: Sonia Jaffe, Anup Malani, Julian Reif
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study how access to credit markets affects the value of insurance. Loans allow consumers to smooth financial shocks over time, reducing the incremental benefits provided by insurance. We derive tractable formulas for the value of insurance that can be taken to data and show how that value varies with loan features. We then apply our framework to health insurance. Access to a five-year loan decreases the values of community- and experience-rated health insurance for the average two-person household by $232–$366 (58–61%). Even for the sickest decile, loan access reduces the value of community-rated insurance by $1099 (17%). Our results suggest that greater credit availability can serve as a substitute for health insurance.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了信贷市场准入如何影响保险的价值。贷款使消费者能够跨期平滑金融冲击，从而减少了保险提供的边际收益。我们推导出可用于数据的保险价值可处理公式，并展示了该价值如何随贷款特征而变化。随后，我们将此框架应用于健康保险。对于平均两人家庭而言，获得五年期贷款使社区评级和经验评级健康保险的价值分别降低了232至366美元（58%至61%）。即使对于最病重的十分位人群，贷款准入也使社区评级保险的价值减少了1099美元（17%）。我们的结果表明，更大的信贷可得性可以作为健康保险的替代品。

title: Amplified challenges for the joint reduction of emissions and inequality, considering the missing-rich
title_zh: 考虑缺失富裕人群时，排放与不平等协同减排的加剧挑战
title_primary: 考虑缺失富裕人群时，排放与不平等协同减排的加剧挑战
title_secondary: Amplified challenges for the joint reduction of emissions and inequality, considering the missing-rich
authors: Markus Nabernegg, Stefan Nabernegg, Thomas Kopp
source: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-18 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Existing studies find that reducing income inequality increases greenhouse gas emissions. However, these analyses usually rely on household surveys that underrepresent top-income groups or on corrections that assume a constant relationship between income and emissions, both of which can distort the results. This study develops a new approach that combines tax microdata to correct the income distribution with machine-learning-based predictions of consumption to better estimate emissions among high-income households. Applied to Ecuador, a highly unequal country with institutional commitments to environmental protection, the approach identifies substantially higher emissions at the top of the income distribution and a non-monotonic pattern of emissions intensity per US$ of income that conventional methods fail to detect. Simulations show that full redistribution raises emissions by 26% under the new approach, compared with 6% in uncorrected surveys. These results underline the importance of better data and methods for evaluating inequality-emission trade-offs and designing redistribution policies.
abstract_zh: 现有研究发现，减少收入不平等会增加温室气体排放。然而，这些分析通常依赖于对高收入群体代表性不足的家庭调查，或依赖于假设收入与排放之间关系恒定的修正方法，这两者都可能扭曲结果。本研究开发了一种新方法，结合税收微观数据以修正收入分布，并利用基于机器学习的消费预测，更准确地估算高收入家庭的排放量。将该方法应用于厄瓜多尔——一个高度不平等且对环境保护有制度承诺的国家——研究发现，收入分布顶端的排放量显著更高，且每美元收入的排放强度呈现非单调模式，而传统方法未能检测到这一现象。模拟显示，在新方法下，完全再分配使排放增加26%，而在未修正的调查中仅为6%。这些结果强调了更优的数据和方法对于评估不平等与排放之间的权衡以及设计再分配政策的重要性。

title: The Employment Consequences of Anti-Dumping Tariffs: Lessons from Brazil
title_zh: 反倾销关税的就业后果：来自巴西的教训
title_primary: 反倾销关税的就业后果：来自巴西的教训
title_secondary: The Employment Consequences of Anti-Dumping Tariffs: Lessons from Brazil
authors: Gustavo de Souza, Haishi Li
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-14 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: How do import tariffs affect employment? We develop an empirical strategy to identify the effects of tariffs using a difference-in-differences strategy, comparing antidumping (AD) investigations resulting in AD tariffs to those not resulting in AD tariffs. We find that an AD tariff decreases imports and increases employment in the protected sector. Moreover, employment in downstream firms decreases, while upstream firms are unaffected because the protected sector sources inputs abroad. Using a model to quantify the aggregate effects, we find that the Brazilian AD policy increased employment by 0.06% at a welfare loss of 2.4%.
abstract_zh: 进口关税如何影响就业？我们采用双重差分策略来识别关税效应，通过比较导致反倾销税的反倾销调查与未导致反倾销税的反倾销调查。研究发现，反倾销税会减少进口并增加受保护部门的就业。此外，下游企业的就业减少，而上游企业未受影响，因为受保护部门从国外采购投入品。通过模型量化总体效应，我们发现巴西的反倾销政策使就业增加0.06%，但福利损失达2.4%。

title: A note on the Diversity Owen value
title_zh: 关于多样性Owen值的一个注记
title_primary: 关于多样性Owen值的一个注记
title_secondary: A note on the Diversity Owen value
authors: Songtao He, Erfang Shan, Yuxin Sun
official: 官方在线 2026-05-12 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Béal et al. (Int J Game Theory 54:12, 2025) introduce the Diversity Owen value for TU-games with diversity constraints, and provide axiomatic characterizations using the axioms of fairness and balanced contributions. However, there exist logical flaws in the proofs of the uniqueness of these characterizations. In this note we provide the corrected proofs of the characterizations by introducing the null player for diverse games axiom. Also, we establish an alternative characterization of the Diversity Owen value by modifying the axioms of the above characterizations.
abstract_zh: Béal等人（Int J Game Theory 54:12, 2025）针对具有多样性约束的TU博弈引入了多样性Owen值，并利用公平性和平衡贡献公理给出了公理化刻画。然而，这些刻画唯一性证明中存在逻辑缺陷。在本注记中，我们通过引入多样性博弈的零参与者公理，提供了修正后的刻画证明。此外，我们通过修改上述刻画的公理，建立了多样性Owen值的另一种刻画。

title: The Decentralization of Liquor Policies in Texas During the Post‐Prohibition Era
title_zh: 后禁酒时期得克萨斯州酒类政策的分散化
title_primary: 后禁酒时期得克萨斯州酒类政策的分散化
title_secondary: The Decentralization of Liquor Policies in Texas During the Post‐Prohibition Era
authors: Andrew Arnold, Holger Sieg
official: 官方在线 2026-04-30 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We examine the decentralization of liquor policies in Texas during the Post-Prohibition era using newly collected historical legislative roll call data. By combining these data with local referendum vote shares, we analyze both legislators' and constituents' preferences on liquor policy. We develop a probabilistic voting model incorporating spillovers and peer effects. Results reveal substantial heterogeneity in preferences among voters, reflecting differing attitudes toward alcohol regulation. Spillover effects are significant, yet the model predicts notable gains from decentralization. Finally, we link legislators' policy preferences to alcohol consumption data and compare model-based welfare estimates with traditional consumption-based measures.
abstract_zh: 我们利用新收集的历史立法唱名表决数据，考察了禁酒令后时期得克萨斯州酒类政策的权力下放情况。通过将这些数据与地方公投投票份额相结合，我们分析了立法者与选民在酒类政策上的偏好。我们构建了一个包含溢出效应和同伴效应的概率投票模型。结果显示，选民偏好存在显著异质性，反映了对酒精监管的不同态度。溢出效应显著，但模型预测权力下放能带来显著收益。最后，我们将立法者的政策偏好与酒精消费数据相关联，并比较了基于模型的福利估计与传统基于消费的衡量指标。

title: Analysing systemic importance of shadow banks in the Indian financial system
title_zh: 分析印度金融体系中影子银行的系统重要性
title_primary: 分析印度金融体系中影子银行的系统重要性
title_secondary: Analysing systemic importance of shadow banks in the Indian financial system
authors: Stanley James Sunil Paul School of Humanities and Social Sciences, Indian Institute of Technology Goa, Ponda, India
official: 官方在线 2025-07-25 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper examines the systemic importance of shadow banks in the Indian financial system. Systemic risk measures of four sectors- banks, shadow banks, real estate, investment banks- are computed with a network model emphasizing the interconnectedness for the period July 2002 to October 2023. Spillovers among these sectors are explored through conditional and aggregate spillover indices estimated with time-varying vector autoregressions. Results reveal that systemic risk was high during crisis periods, such as the global financial crisis and the COVID. Also, the systemic risk measures exhibit significant variations among different sectors. Sector-specific measures capture the build-up of systemic risk in shadow banks before the 2017–18 non-bank financial crisis in India. Lower systemic risk found in banks suggests effective financial oversight in the Indian banking system. Further, the spillover analysis shows shadow banks are major emitters of systemic risk to other sectors. While banks emit the least systemic risk, they are net receivers. The findings highlight the importance of better regulatory measures for shadow banks. Monitoring systemic risk that captures network effects may help in the effective implementation of macroprudential policy.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了印度金融体系中影子银行的系统性重要性。通过一个强调互联性的网络模型，计算了四个部门——银行、影子银行、房地产、投资银行——在2002年7月至2023年10月期间的系统性风险度量。利用时变向量自回归模型估计的条件和总体溢出指数，探讨了这些部门之间的溢出效应。结果显示，在全球金融危机和新冠疫情等危机时期，系统性风险较高。此外，系统性风险度量在不同部门间表现出显著差异。部门特定度量捕捉到了2017-18年印度非银行金融危机前影子银行系统性风险的累积。银行中发现的较低系统性风险表明印度银行体系具有有效的金融监管。进一步，溢出分析显示影子银行是向其他部门传导系统性风险的主要来源。而银行传导的系统性风险最少，且为净接收方。研究结果强调了加强对影子银行监管措施的重要性。监测能够捕捉网络效应的系统性风险，可能有助于宏观审慎政策的有效实施。
